json-formatter.text: Testing real-time comments on this tool.
Formatted a massive 12MB nested payload in under 50ms without freezing the tab. The tree view and error highlighting saved me hours today!
Love that this works 100% locally in the browser with zero data leakage. Very clean UI and keyboard shortcuts.
Great tool! The minify and 2-space / 4-space formatting options are super convenient.

qr-code-generator.text: High resolution SVG and PNG downloads work seamlessly. Generated custom WiFi and contact cards for our office setup in minutes.
Instant live preview as you type URL or vCard details. No watermarks, no forced signups, just works.

regex-tester.text: The colorized match groups and syntax breakdown make tricky lookaheads and email validation formulas crystal clear to troubleshoot.
Super responsive engine with live replacement testing. Exactly what every developer needs bookmarked.

password-generator.text: Cryptographically secure random values with entropy calculations and custom symbol exclusion. Excellent security implementation.
One-click copy and customizable length makes this my go-to password generator.

word-counter.text: Accurate character counts, reading time estimates, and speaking time calculations. Perfect for blog copywriting and SEO meta tags.
Very fast and clean interface with no lag even with long 10,000-word essays.

ai-text-summarizer.text: Gemini AI integration generates razor-sharp bullet summaries from complex research publications. High accuracy and coherence.

base64-encoder-decoder.text: Proper UTF-8 unicode handling without character corruptions, plus direct binary/data-uri conversion. Top notch utility.

image-compressor.text: Compressed multiple PNGs and JPEGs down by over 75% with zero visible fidelity loss, all done locally in the canvas.

loan-emi-calculator.text: The amortization schedule breakdown by month and year helped me plan my mortgage prepayment effortlessly.
